item.title: CMS Targets Rising Drug Costs with New Guard and Globe Pilot Programs
item.description: On Friday, December 19, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) announced two new pilot programs aimed at reducing Medicare spending on prescription drugs and reducing beneficiaries’ out-of-pocket costs. item.title: Major Reforms for UK Employment Law- ERA 2025
item.description: The UK Employment Rights Act 2025 (the “ERA 2025”) has now received Royal Assent. The ERA 2025 will introduce the most significant changes to UK employment law in over a decade. The reforms will affect all organisations with UK staff and will require changes to employment documentation, policies, and processes in the coming months. item.title: FERC Opens New Paths for Co-Located Loads in PJM- What Data Center and Power Generation Developers Need to Know
item.description: Key Takeaways FERC has ordered PJM to overhaul its tariff framework for co-located generation and large loads, finding existing rules unjust and unreasonable and directing the creation of clear, standardized transmission service requirements. item.title: Cannabis Rescheduling Explained
item.description: The Controlled Substances Act of 1970 (CSA) has governed America’s relationship with cannabis since its enactment in 1970. The CSA divides drugs, certain chemicals used to make drugs, and other regulated substances into five distinct categories called “schedules.” Drugs are classified according to their abuse potential and currently accepted medical use. item.title: Congress Abolishes Certain Exemptions for Foreign Private Issuers; Will Now Require Compliance with Section 16(a) Beneficial Ownership Reporting For Directors and Officers
item.description: On Dec. 18, 2025, President Donald Trump signed the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2026 (NDAA) into law. The NDAA includes Section 8103, the Holding Foreign Insiders Accountable Act (HFIAA), which abolishes certain of the current exemptions for securities of foreign private issuers (FPIs) from compliance with certain provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (Exchange Act). item.title: Colorado FAMLI- New Changes in the New Year Impact Process, Duration + More
item.description: Takeaways Changes to Colorado’s Family and Medical Leave Insurance (FAMLI) program taking effect 1.1.26.
